items.name: Big Blind UBC 2019

venue.name: [UBC](https://www.ubc.ca/)
venue.details: Banquet Room 2504 (see Locations tab for more details)

items.information: This competition is right after the multi-venue competition [FMC Americas 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCAmericas2019) and only has blindfolded events. You must register for each competition separately. Spectators are welcome, but must be absolutely silent to allow competitors to concentrate.

items.information: **YOU MUST INCLUDE THE LOCATION YOU ARE ATTENDING IN YOUR REGISTRATION COMMENT.** The competition will be held in multiple locations, across North and South America. Please pay attention to the **date and time zone** of your location! Locations may be added until the 20th of October 23:59UTC so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) in North or South America.
